title: Ravana next sends Akampana
introduction: Ravana next sends Akampana for the battle. As Akampana along with his army sets out for the war, he visualized various bad portents. A deadly conflict ensued between monkeys and demons. Kumuda, Nala and Mainda the chiefs of monkeys creates a great carnage among demons.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चपञ्चशः सर्गः
Thus completes 55th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
वज्रदम्र अक्षम् निहतम् श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षस ईश्वरः |
बल अध्यक्षम् उवाच इदम् कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम्
verses.iast:
vajradamra akṣam nihatam śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣasa īśvaraḥ |
bala adhyakṣam uvāca idam kṛta anjalim upasthitam
verses.translation: Hearing that Vajradamshtra was killed by Angada, Ravana spoke the following words to the General of his forces who, with joined palms, stood near him.

glosses.meaning: who joined his palms in reverence.

verses.devanagari:
शीघ्रम् निर्यान्तु दुर्धर्षा राक्षसा भीम विक्रमाः |
अकम्पनम् पुरस् कृत्य सर्व शस्त्र प्रकोविदम्
verses.iast:
śīghram niryāntu durdharṣā rākṣasā bhīma vikramāḥ |
akampanam puras kṛtya sarva śastra prakovidam
verses.translation: "Let the invincible demons of irresistible courage go forth soon, with Akampana as their head, who is skilled in the use of every weapon and missile."

glosses.meaning: who is skilled in use of every weapon and missile.

verses.devanagari:
एष शास्ता च गोप्ता च नेता च युधि सत्तमः |
भूतिकामश्च मे नित्यं नित्यम् च समरप्रियः
verses.iast:
eṣa śāstā ca goptā ca netā ca yudhi sattamaḥ |
bhūtikāmaśca me nityaṃ nityam ca samarapriyaḥ
verses.translation: "This excellent demon is a chastiser, a protector and a leader in battle. He ever desired my welfare and always loved war."

verses.devanagari:
एष जेष्यति काकत्थ्सौ सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् |
वानरांश्चापरान् घोरान् हनिष्यति न संशयः
verses.iast:
eṣa jeṣyati kākatthsau sugrīvaṃ ca mahābalam |
vānarāṃścāparān ghorān haniṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "There is no doubt that he will prove victorious and Rama, Lakshmana, the mighty Sugreeva and the other terrible monkeys."

verses.devanagari:
परिगृह्य स तामाज्ञाम् रावणस्य महाबलः |
बलं सम्प्रेरयामास तदा लघुपराक्रमः
verses.iast:
parigṛhya sa tāmājJṇām rāvaṇasya mahābalaḥ |
balaṃ samprerayāmāsa tadā laghuparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Taking that command of Ravana, the mighty Akampana of quick resolution then mobilized the army.

verses.devanagari:
ततो नानाप्रहरणा भीमाक्षा भीमदर्शनाः |
निष्पेतू राक्षसा मुख्या बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः
verses.iast:
tato nānāpraharaṇā bhīmākṣā bhīmadarśanāḥ |
niṣpetū rākṣasā mukhyā balādhyakṣapracoditāḥ
verses.translation: Those foremost of demons of terrifying appearance, furnished with every kind of weapon and fearful to look upon, rushed into the fray where their general had dispatched them.

glosses.meaning: furnished with every kind of weapon
where their general had dispatched them.

verses.devanagari:
रथमास्थाय विपुलं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् |
मेघाभो मेघवर्णश्च मेघस्वनमहास्वनः
verses.iast:
rathamāsthāya vipulaṃ taptakāJṇcanabhūṣaṇam |
meghābho meghavarṇaśca meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ
verses.translation: Then, Akampana of the stature and colour of a cloud, whose voice resembled a thunder, ascended his great chariot, decorated with fine gold and set out, surrounded by dreadful demons.

glosses.meaning: of the stature of a cloud
of the colour of a cloud

verses.devanagari:
न हि कम्पयितुम् शक्यह् सुरैऋअपि महा मृधे
अकम्पनस् ततस् तेषाम् आदित्य;इव तेजसा |
verses.iast:
na hi kampayitum śakyah suraiṛapi mahā mṛdhe
akampanas tatas teṣām āditya;iva tejasā |
verses.translation: Even celestials were indeed unable to upset Akampana in a great battle. Hence, among the demons, he was shining like the sun, by his splendour.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य निधावमानस्य सम्रब्धस्य युयुत्सया
अकस्माद् दैन्यम् आगच्चद्द् हयानाम् रथ वाहिनाम् |
verses.iast:
tasya nidhāvamānasya samrabdhasya yuyutsayā
akasmād dainyam āgaccadd hayānām ratha vāhinām |
verses.translation: As he sped on his way, hastened and eager to enter the battle, the horses drawing his chariot were suddenly deprived of their energy.

glosses.meaning: and eager to enter the battle

verses.devanagari:
व्यस्फुरन् नयनम् च अस्य सव्यम् युद्ध अभिनन्दिनः
विवर्णो मुख वर्णश् च गद्गदश् च अभवत् स्वरः |
verses.iast:
vyasphuran nayanam ca asya savyam yuddha abhinandinaḥ
vivarṇo mukha varṇaś ca gadgadaś ca abhavat svaraḥ |
verses.translation: The left eye of Akampana, who delighted in warfare, began to twitch. His countenance grew pale and his voice trembled.

verses.devanagari:
अभवत् सुदिने च अपि दुर्दिने रूक्ष मारुतम्
ऊचुह् खगा मृगाह् सर्वे वाचह् क्रूरा भय आवहाः |
verses.iast:
abhavat sudine ca api durdine rūkṣa mārutam
ūcuh khagā mṛgāh sarve vācah krūrā bhaya āvahāḥ |
verses.translation: At a time of a good day, marked by fine weather, it turned into a day of bad weather with a bitter wind beginning to blow. Birds and beasts uttered cruel and fearful cries.

glosses.meaning: of a good day (marked by a fine weather)
with a bitter wind beginning to blow

verses.devanagari:
स सिम्ह उपचित स्कन्धह् शार्दूल सम विक्रमः
तान् उत्पातान् अचिन्त्य एव निर्जगाम रण आजिरम् |
verses.iast:
sa simha upacita skandhah śārdūla sama vikramaḥ
tān utpātān acintya eva nirjagāma raṇa ājiram |
verses.translation: That demon, who had the shoulders of a lion and the agility of a tiger, disregarding those portents, rushed towards the battle-field.

glosses.meaning: who had the shoulders of a lion
and the agility of a tiger

verses.devanagari:
तदा निर्गच्चतस् तस्य रक्षसह् सह राक्षसैः
बभूव सुमहान् नादह् क्षोभयन्न् इव सागरम् |
verses.iast:
tadā nirgaccatas tasya rakṣasah saha rākṣasaiḥ
babhūva sumahān nādah kṣobhayann iva sāgaram |
verses.translation: While Akampana advanced thus with his troops, an immense tumult arose that seemed to convulse the ocean.

verses.devanagari:
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता वानराणाम् महा चमूः
द्रुम शैल प्रहरणा योद्धुम् समवतिष्ठत |
verses.iast:
tena śabdena vitrastā vānarāṇām mahā camūḥ
druma śaila praharaṇā yoddhum samavatiṣṭhata |
verses.translation: By hearing that clamour of the demons coming for the battle, the huge army of the monkeys, brandishing trees and rocks, was frightened.

glosses.meaning: moving forward with trees and rocks

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् युद्धम् महा रौद्रम् सम्जज्ने कपि रक्षसाम्
राम रावणयोऋअर्थे समभित्यक्त जीविनाम् |
verses.iast:
teṣām yuddham mahā raudram samjajne kapi rakṣasām
rāma rāvaṇayoṛarthe samabhityakta jīvinām |
verses.translation: A highly fierce battle ensued between those monkeys and demons, who were ready to lose their lives for the sake of Rama and Ravana.

glosses.meaning: who were ready to lose their lives
for the sake of Rama and Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे ह्य् अतिबलाह् शूराह् सर्वे पर्वत सम्निभाः
हरयो राक्षसाश् चैव परस्पर जिघंसवः |
verses.iast:
sarve hy atibalāh śūrāh sarve parvata samnibhāḥ
harayo rākṣasāś caiva paraspara jighaṃsavaḥ |
verses.translation: All the monkeys and demons, who were willing to kill each other, were very strong and valiant. All were resembling mountains.

glosses.meaning: who were willing to kill each other

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् विनर्दाताम् शब्दह् सम्युगे अतितरस्विनाम्
शुश्रुवे सुमहान् क्रोधाद् अन्योन्यम् अभिगर्जताम् |
verses.iast:
teṣām vinardātām śabdah samyuge atitarasvinām
śuśruve sumahān krodhād anyonyam abhigarjatām |
verses.translation: The tremendous clamour of the aforesaid warriors, yelling in their rage and strength, making savage cries, were distinctly heard on the battle-field.

verses.devanagari:
रजसः च अरुण वर्ण आभम् सुभीमम् अभवद् भृशम्
उद्धूतम् हरि रक्षोभिः सम्रुरोध दिशो दश |
verses.iast:
rajasḥ ca aruṇa varṇa ābham subhīmam abhavad bhṛśam
uddhūtam hari rakṣobhiḥ samrurodha diśo daśa |
verses.translation: A highly terrific dust, in a thick coppery colour, raised by the monkeys and demons enveloped all the ten quarters.

verses.devanagari:
अन्योन्यम् रजसा तेन कौशेय उद्धूत पाण्डुना
सम्वृतानि च भूतानि ददृशुऋन रण अजिरे |
verses.iast:
anyonyam rajasā tena kauśeya uddhūta pāṇḍunā
samvṛtāni ca bhūtāni dadṛśuṛna raṇa ajire |
verses.translation: The combatants, enveloped by that dust, which was whitish like a piece of silk shaken by the wind, could no longer distinguish each other on the battle-field.

glosses.meaning: which was whitish like a piece of silk shaken by the wind

verses.devanagari:
न ध्वजो न पताका वा वर्म वा तुरगो अपि वा
आयुधम् स्यन्दनम् वा अपि ददृशे तेन रेणुना |
verses.iast:
na dhvajo na patākā vā varma vā turago api vā
āyudham syandanam vā api dadṛśe tena reṇunā |
verses.translation: Neither standard, banner and shield, nor horse, weapon and chariot could be discerned in that pall of dust.

verses.devanagari:
शब्दसः च सुमहांस् तेषाम् नर्दताम् अभिधावताम्
श्रूयते तुमुले युद्धे न रूपाणि चकाशिरे |
verses.iast:
śabdasḥ ca sumahāṃs teṣām nardatām abhidhāvatām
śrūyate tumule yuddhe na rūpāṇi cakāśire |
verses.translation: A great tumultuous clamour, of warriors, making challenging cries and rushing upon each other, was heard on the battle-field, yet in that confusion, no form was visible.

verses.devanagari:
हरीन् एव सुसम्क्रुद्धा हरयो जघ्नुऋआहवे
राक्षसाश् च अपि रक्षांसि निजघ्नुस् तिमिरे तदा |
verses.iast:
harīn eva susamkruddhā harayo jaghnuṛāhave
rākṣasāś ca api rakṣāṃsi nijaghnus timire tadā |
verses.translation: In the darkness, the greatly enraged monkeys killed the monkeys themselves and the demons killed the demons themselves in battle.

verses.devanagari:
ते परांश्च विनिघ्नन्तः स्वांश्च वानरराक्षसाः
रुधिरार्द्राम् तदा चक्रुर्म हीं पङ्कानुलेपनाम् |
verses.iast:
te parāṃśca vinighnantaḥ svāṃśca vānararākṣasāḥ
rudhirārdrām tadā cakrurma hīṃ paṇ^kānulepanām |
verses.translation: Those monkeys and demons killing other and their own people then made the earth dampened with blood, anointing its body with mud.

verses.devanagari:
ततस् तु रुधिर ओघेण सिक्तम् व्यपगतम् रजः
शरीर शव सम्कीर्णा बभूव च वसुम् धरा |
verses.iast:
tatas tu rudhira ogheṇa siktam vyapagatam rajaḥ
śarīra śava samkīrṇā babhūva ca vasum dharā |
verses.translation: Under the stream of blood being sprinkled, the dust was laid, revealing the earth covered with bodies and corpses.

verses.devanagari:
द्रुम शक्ति शिला प्रासैऋगदा परिघ तोमरैः
हरयो राक्षसास् तूर्णम् जघ्नुऋअन्योन्यम् ओजसा |
verses.iast:
druma śakti śilā prāsaiṛgadā parigha tomaraiḥ
harayo rākṣasās tūrṇam jaghnuṛanyonyam ojasā |
verses.translation: The demons and the monkeys vigorously struck each other swiftly with blows from trees, spears, maces, javelins, stones, bars and picks.

verses.devanagari:
बाहुभिः परिघा आकारैऋयुध्यन्तह् पर्वत उपमाः
हरयो भीम कर्माणो राक्षसान् जघ्नुऋआहवे |
verses.iast:
bāhubhiḥ parighā ākāraiṛyudhyantah parvata upamāḥ
harayo bhīma karmāṇo rākṣasān jaghnuṛāhave |
verses.translation: The monkeys of dreadful deeds, resembling mountains, fighting with their arms appearing like iron bars, killed the demons in battle.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसासः च अपि सम्क्रुद्धाह् प्रास तोमर पाणयः
कपीन् निजघ्निरे तत्र शस्त्रैह् परम दारुणैः |
verses.iast:
rākṣasāsḥ ca api samkruddhāh prāsa tomara pāṇayaḥ
kapīn nijaghnire tatra śastraih parama dāruṇaiḥ |
verses.translation: The enraged demons with darts and javelins in their hands, struck the monkeys there with their cruel weapons.

glosses.meaning: with darts and javelins in their hands

verses.devanagari:
अकम्पनः सुसंक्रुद्धो राक्षसानां चमूपतिः
संहर्षयति तान्सर्वान्राक्षसान् भीमविक्रमान् |
verses.iast:
akampanaḥ susaṅkruddho rākṣasānāṃ camūpatiḥ
saṃharṣayati tānsarvānrākṣasān bhīmavikramān |
verses.translation: The extremely enraged Akampana, the general of the army of demons, cheered all those demons by his terrible prowess.

verses.devanagari:
हरयस् त्व् अपि रक्षांसि महा द्रुम महा अश्मभिः
विदारयन्त्य् अभिक्रम्य शस्त्राण्य् आच्चिद्य वीर्यतः |
verses.iast:
harayas tv api rakṣāṃsi mahā druma mahā aśmabhiḥ
vidārayanty abhikramya śastrāṇy āccidya vīryataḥ |
verses.translation: The monkeys however leaping upon them and snatching their weapons through their strength, crushed those demons with blows from large trees and stones.

glosses.meaning: with blows from large trees and stones.

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन्न् अन्तरे वीरा हरयह् कुमुदो नलः
मैन्दसः च परम क्रुद्धश् चक्रुऋवेगम् अनुत्तमम् |
verses.iast:
etasminn antare vīrā harayah kumudo nalaḥ
maindasḥ ca parama kruddhaś cakruṛvegam anuttamam |
verses.translation: Meanwhile Kumuda, Nala and Mainda the courageous monkeys in an outburst of anger, displayed unsuprassed rashness.

verses.devanagari:
ते तु वृक्षैऋमहा वेगा राक्षसानाम् चमू मुखे
कदनम् सुमह चक्रुर् लीलया हरि यूथपाः |
ममन्थू राक्षसान् सर्वे नानाप्रहरणैर्भृशम्
verses.iast:
te tu vṛkṣaiṛmahā vegā rākṣasānām camū mukhe
kadanam sumaha cakrur līlayā hari yūthapāḥ |
mamanthū rākṣasān sarve nānāpraharaṇairbhṛśam
verses.translation: Those exceedingly valiant chiefs of monkeys, as in sport, in the battle-front, with mighty blows of trees, created a great carnage among the demons. All of them repeatedly crushed the demons with every kind of weapon.
